svg.title: Three mechanisms of solution multiplicity
svg.desc: A: two circuit roots with one violating current limits despite passing power limits. B: a neutral circulation continuum bounded but not uniquely selected by current limits. C: multiplying KCL by voltage adds a zero-voltage root with nonzero current residual.
